Maya Patel: ok handing over. primary for this shift is me (EU), Sam is secondary (US). I’ll be on call until 02:00 UTC, Sam takes over after.
Maya Patel: quick context — we had the P1001 kv-cache degradation earlier today, mitigated by a restart and cache-bypass. Customer-facing latencies mostly recovered but some orgs saw 5-10s spikes for embeddings. oncall-bot pushed the incident alert here earlier.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT P1001 detected at 2026-03-14T21:04:27Z - kv-cache thrash - page sent to @maya @sam
Sam O'Neill: got it. I saw the post-mitigation graphs — tail still elevated in us-west-2. Is there a plan to roll a fix or just monitor?
Maya Patel: immediate plan = monitor + rate-limit a few noisy tenants, filed a short-lived feature flag to route heavy retry traffic to backup pool.
Rajiv Kapoor: FYI I created ticket IN-4521 to track follow-ups (link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/IN-4521). It has list of action items and owners.
Lee Chen: assigned myself to investigate root cause of cache eviction storm. I’ll look at kernel-level memory pressure and batch size distributions.
Maya Patel: thanks. For whoever is taking over: runbook pointer -> https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/kv-cache-degradation (steps 1-6 are critical). Copying snippet below:
```
1) check cache eviction rate: `promql: increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])`
2) check long-tail latency: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`
3) if eviction_rate > threshold -> mark tenant with flag `retry_ticketed=true`
4) scale backup-pool: `./infra scale backup-pool --replicas 3`
5) if persistent -> restart cache-worker service: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/cache-worker`
```
Sam O'Neill: copy. Also note we had one noisy client doing aggressive retries, I throttled them with `rate-limiter` rule ID rl-730. I put the blocklist entry in ops-config: https://config.redwood.com/ops/blocks/rl-730
Maya Patel: will add that to the incident timeline.
Rajiv Kapoor: filed follow-up infra ticket INFRA-7893 for autoscaler tweak (link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INFRA-7893). ETA: draft patch by Wed EOD.
Maya Patel: action items summary (I'm writing these in the thread so post-handoff is clean):
- Lee: root cause investigation & short writeup -> due Mon 2026-03-16 (Jira IN-4521#comment)
- Rajiv: autoscaler config change PR -> due 2026-03-18 (INFRA-7893)
- Sam: add a monitoring alert to surface 99th latency per-region -> due Fri 2026-03-13 (ticket MON-221)
- Maya: coordinate customer comms & throttle playbook writeup -> due Tue 2026-03-17
Maya Patel: I'm going offline for a 30m break now (local time), Sam will be primary until I return. Please escalate to pager if anything fires. :coffee: 
Sam O'Neill: taking over. I'll keep eye on us-west-2 and EU tail. If page fires, follow runbook.
Lee Chen: quick note — I captured relevant logs and attached to IN-4521, sample log lines:
```
[2026-03-14T20:58:04Z] cache-worker-12 evict key=org:1234 size=18MB reason=memory_pressure
[2026-03-14T20:58:05Z] api-proxy-5 retry tenant=org:1234 retries=42
[2026-03-14T20:58:06Z] kv-store timeout=2000ms cmd=GET key=org:1234:prefix
```

oncall-bot: Deployment detected - canary rollout of cache-fix v1.0.3 started by @deploy-bot at 2026-03-14T21:21:00Z
deploy-bot: canary checks: 20m window, success on p50/p90 latency only, will not auto-promote on observed p99 deviation
Sam O'Neill: noted. If canary fails, follow fallback: promote backup-pool and rollback canary per runbook step 5.
Maya Patel: post-handoff items: schedule a 30m retro tomorrow at 16:00 UTC — calendar invite created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/retro-P1001. Please add any slides to the retro doc: https://docs.redwood.com/retros/P1001
Rajiv Kapoor: I'll own the retrospective facilitation. Will bring mitigation timeline and PR diff.
Maya Patel: last note — coverage gap on late EU night: our on-call rotation shows nobody in CET+2 between 02:00-04:00 UTC next week. I filed rostering request to ops-leads to close gap (ROSTER-22). For now, we should have Sam extend if alerts persist.
Sam O'Neill: can extend. I'll ping ops-leads if it looks risky.
Lee Chen: leaving a TODO in IN-4521 to add automated tenant-penalty in the rate-limiter to avoid manual blocklisting in future.
Maya Patel: thanks team. closing handoff: primary=Sam O'Neill, secondary=Maya Patel (on return). If anything major, escalate to on-call SRE channel.
Sam O'Neill: acknowledged.
Maya Patel: signing off for real now. glhf :slightly_smiling_face:
